name: How do I choose the right plumbing fixtures for a primary bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right plumbing fixtures for a primary bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider household daily routines, maintenance requirements, and finish durability. In busy family bathrooms, single-handle faucets offer quick, easy operation, while widespread faucets provide a classic look but require cleaning around three separate components. For showers, pressure-balanced valves maintain set temperatures when other water runs, whereas thermostatic valves allow independent control of water volume and temperature. Also consider finishes: matte black and polished chrome show water spots more readily than brushed nickel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Evaluate valve functionality like pressure-balanced versus thermostatic controls, consider how easily finishes show water spots, and match fixture styles to your daily routine.
